newsitem.title: UK: GOLF-FACTFILE ON OPEN CHAMPION LEONARD.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-FACTFILE ON OPEN CHAMPION LEONARD.

text.p: Factfile on British Open champion Justin Leonard:
Full name: Justin Charles Garret Leonard.
Height: Five feet nine inches (1.75 metres)
Victories: U.S. Amateur 1992, Buick Open 1996, Kemper Open 1997, British Open 1997.
British Open record: 1993 Missed Cut, 1995 T-58, 1996 MC, 1997 1st.
Earnings: U.S. Tour $2,496,778. Europe 259,740 pounds sterling

Highlights: His mentors include fellow Texans Tom Kite and Ben Crenshaw. Nicknamed "Jasper" by friends. Selected by Cosmopolitan Magazine as one of the 25 most eligible bachelors in the world last year.
